(declare (standard-bindings) (extended-bindings))
(define calls '(##btq-insert! ##btq-remove! ##btq-reposition! ##toq-insert! ##toq-remove! ##toq-reposition! ##thread-btq-insert! ##thread-btq-remove! ##thread-toq-remove! macro-thread-btq-container-set! macro-thread-toq-container-set! macro-btq-init! macro-toq-init!))
(define (inventory path)
  (let ((rows '()))
    (define (visit x owner)
      (if (pair? x)
          (if (and (eq? (car x) 'cond-expand) (pair? (cdr x)) (pair? (cadr x)) (eq? (caadr x) 'enable-smp))
              (for-each (lambda (body) (visit body owner)) (cdadr x))
          (if (and (symbol? (car x)) (memq (car x) '(define-prim define ##define-macro)) (pair? (cdr x)))
              (let* ((head (cadr x)) (name (if (pair? head) (car head) head)))
                (for-each (lambda (body) (visit body name)) (cddr x)))
              (begin
                (if (and (symbol? (car x)) (memq (car x) calls))
                    (set! rows (cons (list owner (car x)) rows)))
                (visit (car x) owner)
                (let loop ((tail (cdr x)))
                  (cond ((pair? tail) (visit (car tail) owner) (loop (cdr tail)))
                        ((not (null? tail)) (visit tail owner)))))))))
    (call-with-input-file path
      (lambda (port)
        (let loop ()
          (let ((form (read port)))
            (if (not (eof-object? form)) (begin (visit form 'top-level) (loop)))))))
    (write (list path (reverse rows))) (newline)))
